tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bsnyen pa'i cho ga bar pa la brten nas bdag nyid 'jug pa'i ngag 'don bzhugs so// rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug par 'dod pa'i gang zag cho ga bsdus pa la dga' ba'i ngor/ bsnyen pa 'bring po la brten te bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i tshul gsal bar brjod par bya'o/ /de la sngon du bya ba'i rim pa thams cad legs par tshar nas/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis kha lag bkru/ sa ma ya satwaṃ gyis stan la 'dug ste/ sa skya pa ltar na sngon 'gro'i gtor ma sngon du 'gro ba las/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ hūm̐ badz+rā na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza rat+na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dwangs shing / thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+mā ṇāṃ ād+ya nutun+na twata/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa yi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ba lin+te swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ yang a kā ro dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang / /gang yang sa la bsten pa rnams/ /sems can kun la dge don du/ /byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ badz+ra satwa sa byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ yig brgya lan bdun brjod/ de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab ste/ bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin las/ hūm̐/ tsan dan chu la bden pa bdar ba yis/ /phyogs su gtor bas yongs su dag gyur te/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur nas/ /dri med 'dod yon dag dang ldan gyur cig /oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ sho dha na ye swā hā/

yang badz+ra satwa dang / badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs sngar bzhin/ /rol mo yang dbul/ de nas bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la/ chos la/ dge 'dun la'o/ /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi/ /swa bhā wa sngar bzhin dang / stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum bsgreng ba'i gung mo'i rtse mo la dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rang gi thugs kar bstod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dril bu kha nang du bstan nas bsnyems pa'i tshul gyis dkur brten par gyur pa'i lkog mar hriḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lce'i thad ka'i 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ de lce la thim pas lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ lag pa gnyis su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ /de'i steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po/ /de zhu bas rdo rje'i lag pa/ sor mo rnams rdo rje'i rtse gcig par gyur/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ du gyur/ hūm̐ gi sgras gdug pa can thams cad btul/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub brtan par mdzad/

rdo rje'i rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa las/ khro bo rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog sngon po/ zhal khro ba dang bcas pas bzhad pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur khro bo'i dril bu dang bcas pa bsnyems pa'i tshul gyis 'chang ba/ /g.yas pas khro bo'i rdo rje blangs te dregs pas gsor bar brtson pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ 'od zer 'bar ba kun tu 'khrug pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i rdo rje phreng ba'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ khro gnyer dang bcas shing khro bo'i rdo rje'i lta bas gzigs pa/ /oṃ gṛh+na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārkaka hūm̐ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ lan bzhi dang / oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ra ni a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ dhar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ kar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā a na lārkaka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ lan lnga dang / oṃ ṭaruṃ/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārkaka hūm̐/ hūm̐ badz+ra na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nai tri bhan dha sar+b+ba bigh+nān/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha ba rak+ṣa sar+b+baṃ swā hā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ druṃ ban+dha haṃ/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pā sha hriḥ.oṃ badz+ra pā taṃ ke pā tad+ge ni raṭa/ hri badz+ra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ruṭ+ra maṭ+ra/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma/ hūm̐ badz+ra ban+dhā baṃ bsrung 'khor ro/ /yang mchod pa bsang sbyang sngar bzhin bya/ rang rdo rje rgyur gyur pa'i thugs ka nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul te srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du zhugs par gyur/

mchod yon sogs kyi mchod pa sngar bzhin bya/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta pra ṇā me na badz+ra ban+dhā nāṃ ka ro mi/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+d+ya nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa mi māṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra bar+t+ta na ya āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhar+m+ma pra bar+t+ta ya māṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza kar+m+ma ṇe āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kar+m+ma ku ru māṃ/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang de bzhin gshegs pa dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis spyan snga dang de bzhin gshegs pa dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi spyan sngar sdig pa thams cad bla na med pa'i so sor bshags pas so sor bshags par bgyi/ phyogs bcu na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos yang dag par song ba dang yang dag par zhugs pa rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi tshogs kyi bsod nams thams cad la rgya cher rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa thams cad chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya ba'i phyir bskul bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa gang yin pa de thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar 'tshal lo/

/gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na lha dang mi rnams kyi me tog gi bye brag yid las byung ba'am chu las skyes pa'am thang las skyes pa gang dag yod pa de rnams 'di lta ste/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par zhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pa pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+phar ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ gang yang nas/ lha dang mi rnams kyi zhes pa'i bar/ gos dang dpag bsam gyi shing dbul ba'i bar kun gyi mgo dang / gang dag nas/ dbul bar bgyi'o zhes pa'i bar 'di dpag bsam gyi shing dbul ba'i kun gyi mjug tu sbyar ro/ /bdug pa'i bye brag lhan cig skyes pa'am yang dag par sbyar ba'am yongs su gyur pa can/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta zhes pa dang / pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pa gsang mchod kyi bar kun gyi thog mthar sbyar ro/ /dhū pa zhes pa go brje'o/ /snang ba'i bye brag yid las byung ba'am rin po che'i 'od dam mar me'i snang ba la sogs pa/ ā lo ke/ dri'i bye brag lhan cig skyes pa'am yang dag par sbyar ba'am/ yongs su gyur pa can/ gan+dha/ rin po che'i ri bo'am rgya mtsho'i rin po che'i tshogs/ bo dh+yad+ga rat+nā laṅka ra/ rgod pa dang sgeg pa dang dga' ba dang rtsed 'jo'i bde ba'i bye brag hās+ya lās+ya ra ti kṛ ṭā sau khyā nu t+ta ra/ dpag bsam gyi shing ngam gos kyi shing / a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅka ra wasatra/ ma rgal ba rnams bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir dang / ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir dang /

sems can gyi khams ma lus pa rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las yang dag par bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bo dhi tsit+ta/ sems can thams cad yo byad thams cad kyis yang dag par 'byor zhing phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'dod pa tsam la rag las par gyur cig ma hā badz+rod+bha ba dā na pā ra mi ta/ sems can thams cad mi dge ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' thams cad dang yang dag par bral bar gyur cig dge ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' thams cad dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig anut+ta ra ma hā bodhi ha ra shī la pā ra mi ta/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad kyis lus la yang dag par brgyan par byas pa dang / rtag tu phan tshun 'jigs pa med pa dang / zhe 'gras pa med par zhugs shing mig dang yid mngon par dga' ba dang chos zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan par gyur cig anut+ta ra ma hā dhar+m+ma ba bo dhi k+ṣān+ti pā ra mi ta/ sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa dang ldan pa dang sangs rgyas nyid du yongs su gzhol zhing 'khor ba yongs su mi spong ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan par gyur cig san+pā rā pa ri t+yā gā nut+ta ra ma hā bīr+ya pā ra mi ta/ sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa dang mngon par shes pa rnams dang rig pa thams cad dbang du gyur pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig anut+ta ra sau khya bi ha ra dh+yā na pā ra mi ta/ sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab dang ye shes rnams dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob ste bzo dang bstan bcos thams cad shes shing sgyu rtsal dang ldan la gsang ba'i cho ga shes pa dang de kho na nyid mthong ste nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad yang dag par gcod pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig

a nut+ta ra kle sha tshe dang sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma sa man+ta dzñā na ma hā pradzñā pā ra mi/ kā ya nir+yā ta na/ mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur yang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa'i mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med pa rab mkhyen nas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgyas pas te/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /wāka nir+yā ta na/ gu h+ye/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid 'bul gyi bdag dus thams cad dang rnam pa thams cad du so sor bzhes su gsol/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mgon po khyed rnams kyis dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub bdag la bstsal du gsol/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang yang dag par ldan pa'i bde ba nyid dang yid bde ba nyid kyis mi'i mchog sangs rgyas su tshe 'di nyid la gyur cig bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /ma rgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /tshogs bsag pa'o/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ hūm̐ a/ /a ā i ī/ u ū/

ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄/ ye ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥlan gnyis dang / oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hṛ aḥ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hṛ aḥ rnam snang / mi bskyod/ rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ rdo rje rkun ma/ a n+yo n+yā nu ga tāḥ sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma pa ra pa rā nu pra biṣ+ṭa sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma badz+rāñdza li/ a d+yan+tā nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥ sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma badz+ra ban+dha traṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dri ḍho me bha ba/ shā shwa to me bha ba/ hṛ da yaṃ me/ adhi tiṣ+ṭha sar+b+ba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ.oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba a pa ya ā kar+ṣa ṇi bi sho dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di las bskyab tu gsol/ bdag cag rnams sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / khyed la skyabs su mchi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bis+pho ṭa ya/ sar+b+ba a pā ya ban+dha ni pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sar+b+ba a pa ya gti bh+yaḥ sar+b+ba satwan sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi shwa ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ kar+m+ma hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ rat+na badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ dhar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ kar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rā dzā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rā ga hoḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu saḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rat+na oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra te dzaḥ.aṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra ke tu traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra ha sa haḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+maḥ hriḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa dhaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ

oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma kaṃ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ o badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ma le traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hriḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ya aḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ramuḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hriḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra s+phoṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra be sha aḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ phyag rgya bcing ba spyi'i cho ga'o/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams rang gi snying ga'i zla ba la thim nas/ lha thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang skad cig gis rdor sems su gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje'i lte bar badz+ra satwa/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i phyogs su rang gi sems badz+ra satwa/ a ā i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥbacu drug gi rnam pa de zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du badz+ra satwa/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha a laṃk+ṣaḥ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa de badz+ra satwa dang bcas pa las dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar badz+ra satwas mtshan pa/ badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra satwa lan gsum dang / rdo rje de las rdor sems kyis gtso byas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lha dpag tu med pa sprul/ de sems can gyi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lhar byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje dbyings thams cad rdo rje der zhugs pas/ rdo rje de'ang rang gi rigs kyi lha thams cad kyi rdul phra rab 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/

bdag ni sems dpa' kun bdag grags/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bdag la gnas/ /badz+ra satwa/ zla ba rdo rje de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ badz+ra satwa haṃ/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa/ sa ma o haṃ/ sa ma ya satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ lan bzhi dang / badz+ra satwa lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa lan gsum/ rang gzhi lus las tha dad du byed/ gzhi lus kyi snying gar zhugs/ stong gsum pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi tshad tsam gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ lan gsum dang / mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul/ rang rdor sems su gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ pra tī ts+tsha badz+ra hūm̐ hoḥ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ye/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho/ nas/ ho'i bar dang / badz+rā bhi ṣiñtsa/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ dhar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ kar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ ṭaruṃ/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti a bh-i ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā mā bhi ṣe ka taḥ kye dpal rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad yin/ /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/

/oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐ snying ga'i bdag 'jug go /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor snying gar thim/ sa ma ya a/ lha'i gnas nyer brgyad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sngar bzhin/ sa ma aḥ badz+ra satwa aḥ badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra satwa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭa miṭa/ su ra ta satwaṃ badz+ra satwa dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ a haṃ/ badz+ra satwa lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra satwa lan gsum mo/ /snying ga'i g.yas su rdo rje rgyal po gser mdog phyag gnyis kyi lcags kyus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra rā dza aḥ aṅku sho haṃ/ badz+ra rā dzo haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha nas/ /a haṃ gi bar sngar bzhin no/ /badz+ra rā dza/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza dzaḥ 'di gnyis lan gsum gsum mo/ /snying ga'i g.yon du chags pa dmar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mda' ut+pal dmar po kha ma bye ba'i mde'u can/ rdo rje'i gzhu rna ba'i bar du bkang nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'bigs par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra rāg aḥ sha ro haṃ/ badz+ra rā go haṃ aṃ ku sha sog sngar bzhin/ badz+ra rā ka oṃ badz+ra rā ga hoḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /rgyab tu rdo rje legs pa ljang gu dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis bsnams nas legs so sbyin pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra sā dhū aḥ tuṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ badz+ra pā dhū ra haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra sā dhū/ oṃ badz+ra sā dhū haḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /dpral bar rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rdo rje rin po che rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'jog cing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra rat+na aḥ rat+na ma haṃ/ badz+ra gar+bho haṃ/

aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra rat+na oṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /ltag par gzi brjid nyi ma'i mdog can/ phyag g.yas kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa yod pa'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang bar mdzad pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra te dzaḥ.aḥ badz+ra sūr+yo haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra te dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra te dzaḥ oṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /phrag pa g.yas su rgyal mtshan phyag g.yas dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog can gyi rgyal mtshan phrag pa'i phyogs su bsgreng ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la nges par sbyor bar mdzad cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya āḥ badz+ra ke tu aḥ ke tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra yaṣ+ṭi ra ham̐/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra ke tu/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu tri lan gsum gsum mo/ /so'i phreng ba gnyis su bzhad pa dkar po phyag g.yas pas dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i so'i phreng ba gnyis kha 'gram g.yas su 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dzum pa rmad du byung ba la nges par sbyor zhing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra hā sa aḥ smi ta ma haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra ha sa/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa haṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /lkog ma rdo rje chos dkar dmar phyag g.yon pa rdo rje pad+ma'i sdong bu dkur brten zhing / g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis snying gar rdo rje pad+ma kha 'byed pa sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra dhar+m+ma aḥ pad+mo haṃ/ badz+ra ne tro haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hriḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /nu ma gnyis kyi bar du rdo rje rnon po phyag g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis thugs kar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams shing / g.yas pas rdo rje ral gris de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'debs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/

sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa aḥ khaṭa go haṃ/ badz+ra bud+dhi ra haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa dhaṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /lte bar rdo rje rgyu gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pa'i gung mo'i rtse mo la dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra he ru aḥ aṅku sha haṃ maṇ+ḍa haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra he tu/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ lce la smra ba zangs kyi mdog can phyag g.yas pas dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lce bsnams pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la smra bar mdzad cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra bhā ṣa aḥ dzi hwa haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra bhā ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /spyi bor rdo rje las zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar dkar po/ zhal gyi 'og nas skyed pa'i bar dmar skya/ rked pa'i bar dang phyag gnyis sngo skya/ brla gnyis ser skya/ lhag ma sngon po/ phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra kar+m+ma aḥ kar+m+ma aḥ kar+m+ma badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra bi shwa haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra kar+m+ma oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma kaṃ lan gsum gsum mo/ nam tshoms su srung ba gser gyi mdog can phyag gnyis kyi mtha' gnyis su rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i rdo rje'i go cha bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la go bskon pa'i tshul/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra rak+ṣa aḥ barmo haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra rak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /khar gnod sbyin nag po lto ba yangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdigs par mdzad pa sa ma ya aḥ

badz+ra yak+ṣa aḥ daṃṣ+ṭ+ri ra haṃ/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍo haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /dku gnyis su rdo rje khu tshur ser po dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis 'char ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra san+dha aḥmuṣ+ṭa ra haṃ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra san+dha/ oṃ badz+ra san+dha ba/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' g.yon du sgeg ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis mnyam pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing g.yon du cung zad 'dud pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra dwā ya ma haṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yahaṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra lā s+ya/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /rdo rje rin chen gyi g.yon du 'phreng ba ma ser mo rdo rje rin po che'i phreng bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dbang bskur bar mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra mā le aḥ rat+na mā le haṃ/ badz+ra mā le haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra mā le/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /rdo rje chos kyi g.yon du glu ma dkar dmar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gzhus pi wang brdung ba la brtson pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra gī ti aḥ bī ṇa ma haṃ/ badz+ra gī to haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra gī ti/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hṝḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /rdo rje las kyi g.yon du gar ma sna tshogs mdog sngar bzhin/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis bsnams nas gar byed pa/ sa ma ya a/ badz+ra nṛ t+ya aḥ badz+ra nṛ t+ya ka ra palpo haṃ/ badz+ra nṛ t+ya haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra nṛ t+ya/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ya aḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /gsang gnas su bdug pa mo dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i spos snod bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tshim par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra dhū pe aḥ dhū po haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra dhū pe/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pa hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /mgo bor me tog ma ser mo phyag g.yon rdo rje me tog gi snod 'dzin cing g.yas pas me tog gi char 'bebs par mdzad pa/

sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥ puṣ+po haṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+po haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /mig gnyis su mar me ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje mar me'i sdong bu bsnams te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams snang ba'i tshogs kyis mchod par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥ dī po haṃ/ badz+ra dī po haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin badz+rā lo ke aḥ oṃ badz+rā lo ke hṛḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /nu ma dang brang dang snying gar byug pa ma sna tshogs mdog sngar bzhin/ phyag g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dri'i dung phor bsnams te/ phyag g.yas kyis dri'i sprin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ gan+dhaṃ/ badz+ra gan+dho haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra gan+dhe/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /brla g.yas su lcags kyu dkar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags kyus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ a badz+ra aṅku sha haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra aṅku sha/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /brla g.yon la zhags pa ma phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje zhags pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jug par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra pā sha aḥ pā sho haṃ/ badz+ra pā sho haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra pā sha/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /byin pa g.yas su lcags sgrog ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags sgrog gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'ching bar mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra s+pho ṭa aḥ s+pho ṭo haṃ/ badz+ra s+pho to haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /byin pa g.yon du 'bebs pa sna tshogs mdog sngar bzhin/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dril bu bsnams te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'bebs par mdzad pa/ g.yon gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ

ghaṇ+ṭo haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+rā be sha aḥ oṃ badz+ra be sha aḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /sgrub pa'o/ /sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa thams cad gzhi lus rten pa nyer brgyad dang bcas pa la bye ma la chu blug pa bzhin du dbyer med du gyur/ bsgrub chen no/ /sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu dri sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ a haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gī shwa ri hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum dang / sa ma ya nas/ badz+ra dhā tu'i bar 'og ma bzhi la'ang 'gre'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum ste/ dam rgya'o/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa/ yang lha thams cad kyi lkog mar hṛḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lce'i 'dab mar a las zla ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa chur nyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ rdo rje'i lte ba la rang rang gi chos kyi yi ge/ badz+ra dzñā na/ lan lnga dang / sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ā na ya swa/ a ho su kha/ sā dhu/ sā dhu/ su ma ha satwaṃ/ rū po te t+ya/ ar+thatha prāp+ti/ ha ha hūm̐ he/ sar+b+ba kā ri/ duḥkhats+tshe dang / bud+dha bo dhiḥpra ti shap+ta/ su ba shi satwaṃ/ nir+bha ya satwaṃ/ sha trunabhak+ṣaḥ sar+b+ba sid+dhi/ ma hā ra ti/ ru bha sho bh+ye/ sho ḍa sau khya/ sar+b+ba pū dze/ pra h+la da ni/ pha lā ga me/ su te dzā gri/ su gan+dhāṃ gi/ ā yā hi dzaḥ ā yā hi/ hūm̐ he s+pho ṭa baṃ/ ghaṇ+ḍa aḥ.aḥrnams kyis mtshan pa chos rgya'o/ /lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tu lnga dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa/ oṃ badz+ra rā dzāḥ oṃ badz+ra rā ga oṃ badz+ra sā dhu/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na/ oṃ badz+ra te dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ke tu/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa/ oṃ badz+ra he tu/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa/

oṃ badz+ra san+ti/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya/ oṃ badz+ra mā l+ya/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti/ oṃ badza nṛ t+ya/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe/ oṃ dz+ra puṣ+pe/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ā be shaḥlas rgya'o/ /lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ badz+ra dhā tu nas/ ā be sha'i bar oṃ med pa sngar bzhin te/ phyag chen no/ /satwa badz+ri a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ lan lnga dang / rat+na badz+ri a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ dhar+m+ma badz+ri a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ kar+m+ma badz+ri a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ lan bzhi dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dri ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sar+b+ba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sar+b+ba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsi t+taṃ shrīḥyaṃ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa a/ lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na traṃ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ nas/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐ gi bar sngar bzhin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pas na/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra hata/ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ badz+ra mā l+ya traṃ/ rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pas/ /oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma ga ya ne badz+ra gī ti hṛḥ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma ka rotabha ba badz+ra nṛ t+ya a/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ tak+ki dzaḥho/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa'/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'i/ a las skyes pa'i dril bu de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje snyems ma/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa'i bdag po dam pa kun gyi mchog dbang phyug gi dam pa de nyid chos kyi mchog gi bka' yang dag par stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid mchog /srid pa'i mchog ni mdzad pa yin/ /dhar+m+ma a/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu myur/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i mchog tu gsang ba'i theg pa chen po'i sbyor ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi dam tshig go /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang / /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pas/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su bsgrags/ yid kyi gzugs ni brtan phyir ro/ /oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng grub mchog /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gi/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ mo haṃ/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'greng ba'i lte bar rang rang gi snying po'i sngags mgo gyen du bstan pa/

badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gis gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig gi mnyam par/ /gyur pa bdag ni som nyi med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig las/ /mi ldog par ni bdag 'gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa mchog yin no/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta pra nā me na badz+ra ban+dha nāṃ ka ro mi/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'dir ni bstsal du gsol/ /tshigs bcad 'di gnyis bar bsnyen pa rkyang pa la mi dgos/ rang rnal 'byor chen por gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor stong gsum pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi tshad tsam du gyur/ de las mdun du/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ khang pa brtsegs pa sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs med pa/ rtse mo rdo rje dang rin po che las byas pa/ dbus su āḥ siṃ āḥ seng ge'i khri shar du hūm̐ ga hūm̐ las glang po'i khri/ lhor traḥ ba traḥ las rta'i khri/ nub tu hṛḥmaṃ hṝḥ las rma bya'i khri/ byang du aṃ ga aṃ las nam mkha' lding gi khri/ lha thams cad kyi gnas su hṛ las pad+ma/ gtso bo lnga'i pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ snying ga nas sems ma bzhi/ oṃ badz+ra satwa muṣ+ṭi aḥ mi bskyod pa dang de'i rigs/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na muṣ+ṭi taṃ/ rin 'byung dang de'i rigs/ /oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma muṣ+ṭi khaṃ/ 'od dpag med dang de'i rigs/ /oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma muṣ+ṭi haṃ/ don grub dang de'i rigs kyi lha rnams sprul/

badz+ra dhā tu/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du rnam snang dkar po rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ lha rdzas kyi dar la'i stod g.yogs mnabs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba dang ldan pa/ zhal bzhi pa dang po shar du gzigs pa 'khod/ satwa badz+ri/ mdun du sems ma rdo rje ma'i ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po/ rat+na badz+ri g.yas su rdo rje rin chen ma'i ngo bo yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i rtse mo dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa/ dhar+m+ma badz+ri rgyab tu rdo rje chos ma'i ngo bo pad ma dkar mar 'dab ma bcu drug la 'dab ma brgyad thur du gyes shing kha bye ba/ 'dab ma brgyad gyen du bltas pa kha ma bye ba'i bar du rdo rje rtse lnga pa chud pa/ kar+m+ma badz+ri g.yon du rje las ma'i ngo bo sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ lte ba dkar/ mdun gyi rwa gsum sngo/ g.yas kyi ser/ g.yon gyi ljang / rgyab kyi dmar ba/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ shar gyi dbus su glang po che'i khri dang pad zla la mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ badz+ra satwa/ mdun du rdo rje sems dpa'/ badz+ra rā dza/ g.yas su rgyal po/ badz+ra rā ga rgyab tu chags pa/ badz+ra sā dhū/ g.yon du legs pa sngar bzhin dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ lhor rta'i khri dang pad zla la rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje rin po che bsnams pa/ badz+ra rat+na sogs kyis rdo rje rin chen sogs bzhi po mdun g.yas rgyab g.yon du dang / oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hūm̐/ nub tu rma bya'i khri dang pad zla la 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas rdo rje pad ma bsnams pa/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma sogs kyis sems dpa' bzhi po sngar bzhin dang /

oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma hūm̐/ byang du nam mkha' lding gi khri dang pad zla la don grub ljang gu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa/ badz+ra kar+m+ma sogs kyis sems dpa' bzhi sngar bzhin bskyed/ sgeg sogs bzhi shar lho lho nub nub byang byang shar gyi nang gi re'u mig dang / bdug pa sogs bzhi phyi'i grwa bzhi dang / sgo ba bzhi la phyi nang gi shar lho sogs sbyar/ sar+b+ba saṃ ska ri pa ri shud+dha dhar+m+ma te ga ga na sa mud+ga te ma hā na ya pa ri wā res/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar gyi snam bu la skal bzang nyis brgya zhe dgu dkar po g.yas pas dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs dkar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje rin chen cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ sar+b+ba saṃ ska sogs/ lho'i snam bu la skal bzang nyis brgya zhe dgu ser po g.yas pas rin po che rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'jog cing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i can gyis dbang bskur ba/ sar+b+ba saṃ ska ra sogs/ nub kyi snam bu la skal bzang nyis brgya zhe dgu dkar dmar g.yon pa snyems pa dang bcas pas rdo rje pad ma'i sdong bu dkur brten cing / g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis thugs kar rdo rje pad+ma'i 'dab mar kha 'byed par mdzad pas rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba/ saṃ ska ra sogs/ byang gi snam bu la skal bzang nyis brgya zhe dgu sna tshogs mdog sngar bzhin/ g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ badz+ra dhā tu ra haṃ swa yaṃ/ badz+ra satwa rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dbus su lha'i sngags mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu/

dus mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer can rdor sems kyi snying po'o/ /lha thams cad kyi sngags ci nus su bzlas pa bya'o/ /bsnyen pa rkyang pa byed pa ni de'i rjes su/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la/ /rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /don yod rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la/ /rdo rje chags pa bde chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la/ /rdo rje legs pa sems dpa'i mchog /rdo rje mgu ba mgu ba che/ /rab dgyes rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dgyes khyod la/ /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje don/ /rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che/ /nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje phyug /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'od khyod la/ /sems can don rab rdo rje dpal/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed/ /rdo rje chen po rin chen dpal/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpal khyod la/ /rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che/ /rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la/ /rdo rje chos rab de nyid don/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab dga' byed/ /'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje spyan/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la/ /rdo rje rno ba theg pa che/ /rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje blo khyod la/ /rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che/ /rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po/ /rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying po la/ /rdo rje gsung ba rab rib mchog

/rdo rje bzlas pa rab grub sbyin/ /mi gsung rdo rje mchog grub pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la/ /rdo rje las rab rdo rje'i bka'/ /las kyi rdo rje kun rab 'gro/ /rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun khyod la/ /rdo rje bsrung ba bstan pa che/ /rdo rje go cha sra ba che/ /brtson 'grus mchog ni thub par dka'/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje brtson 'grus la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi zad pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la/ /rdo rje mtshams sbyor rab bsdus nyid/ /rdo rje 'ching ba rab sgrol byed/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma nāṃ ār+ya nut+pan+na twata/ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pas na/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra hata oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ rdo rje chos kyi glur blangs pa/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma ga ya neḥ badz+ra gī ti hṛḥ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma ka rad+bho ba badz+ra nṛ t+ya aḥ de bzhin du badz+ra la s+ya sogs kyi go sar badz+ra dhū pe sogs sbyar ba dang / oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhā tu/ a nut+tar pū dza s+pha ra na kar+m+ma sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du badz+ra dhā tu'i gnas su/ badz+ra satwa dang / badz+ra rat+na dang / badz+ra dhar+m+ma dang / badz+ra kar+m+ma bcug pa dang / oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sar+b+ba āt+ma nir+yā ta na 'og ma bzhi la'ang sbyar/ pū dza s+pha ra ṇa kar+m+ma badz+ri aḥ pū dza s+pha ra ṇa kar+m+ma gṛ dza/ ya nu rā ga ṇa pū dza s+pha ra ṇa kar+m+ma ba ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ sā dhu ka rā pū dza s+pha ra ṇa kar+m+ma tuṣ+ṭi aḥ oṃ na maḥ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta 'og ma bzhi'i mgor sbyar kā ya a bhi ṣe ka rat+ne bh+yo badz+ra ma ṇi oṃ/

sūr+ye bh+yo badz+ra te dzi ni dz+wa la hṛḥ a sha pa ri pū ra ṇi dh+wa dzā gri traṃ/ ma hā prī ti pri mo t+ya ka re bh+yo badz+ra hās+ya oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta/ 'og ma brgyad kyi mgor sbyar/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma sa mā dhi bistu no ma hā dhar+m+mā gri hṛ/ pradzñā pā rā mi tā ni dha te stu no mi ma hā gho ṣā ṇu ge dhaṃ/ tsakrā k+ṣa ra pa ri bar+t+tā ri sar+b+ba sū tran+ta na ye stu no mi sar+b+ba maṇ+ḍa le hūm̐/ san+dha bhā ṣa bud+dha saṃ gī ti nir+gha yaṃ stu no mi badz+ra bā tse baṃ/ dhū pa me gha s+pha ra ṇa pū dzā kar+m+me ka ra ka ra/ puṣ+pa pra sa ra s+pha ra ṇa pū dzā kar+m+me ki ri ki ri/ ā lo ke dz+wa la s+pha ra ṇa pū dzā kar+m+me ka ra ka ra/ gan+dha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa pū dzā kar+m+me ku ru ku ru/ phyag bzhi bya/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi shwa ri hūm̐/ o badz+ra mu ཿnas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bha ṣiñtsa/ sarba mu traṃ me tri ḍāṃ ku ru ba ra ka ba tse na baṃ/ badz+ra tuṣ+ya hoḥ badz+ra satwa/ yig brgya brjod/ dge ba bsngos la/ bdag gis cho ga ma tshang ba gang dag bgyis pa de bzod par mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs par mdzad/ /de nas slar yang 'byon par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa muḥ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma kaṃ/ oṃ legs so rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos khyod legs pa ste/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /mdo sde 'di ni legs bshad pa/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po sngon bsdus pa'o/ /bsnyen pa 'bring po'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na bsnyen pa'i rjes su ṭak+ki hūm̐ dza nas/

yid kyi gzugs ni bstan phyir ro'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /mtshan brgyas bstod/ ming brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag gis/ /bdag cag gis ni bstod pa yin/ /theg pa chen po rtogs pa yi/ /tshul chen yang ni rgyas par mdzod/ /mgon po khyed la gsol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yi/ /cho ga mchog ni bshad par gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+dha nāṃ ka ro mi/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang yin/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /stobs chen rdo rje can bdag yin/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /phyag na rdo rje bstan bdag yin/ /bdag po rdo rje chen po bdag /byin gyis brlab pa mi 'dor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ aḥlas rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje/ badz+ra satwa u tiṣ+ṭha/ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi maṭa/ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ ri rab kyi rtse mo nas 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ /khro bo me ltar 'bar ba bskyed pa nas/ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ gyi bar srung 'khor bzhin bya/ badz+ratagha ṭa sogs/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sgo phye/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ dzaḥ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi khro bo mi'u thung lta bu/ zhal bzhi pa/ gsus khyim che ba phyag dang po gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ 'og ma gnyis g.yas 'khor lo g.yon rdo rje dang dril bu dkur brten pa/ sku mdog ser po bkug nas gzhal yas khang la thim pas zhal bzhi sgo bzhi/ khog pa gzhal yas khang / ral pa la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan du gyur/ ma hā badz+ra tsakra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha hūm̐/ hūm̐ las khro bo mtha' yas gser mdog can/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar/ phyag dang po gnyis mnyam gzhag g.yas gnyis na phreng ba/

mda'/ g.yon gnyis sdigs mdzub gzhu/ khro bo rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ khro bo sprin 'dra char sprin lta bu g.yas dkar/ g.yon ser/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon zhags pa sdigs mdzub/ gzhu bsnams pa/ khro bo gsus po che dmar po rdo rje phreng ba'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ rgyal ba dmar po g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar stag lpags can/ phyag g.yas bzhin rdo rje/ dbyug to/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na/ sdigs mdzub dkur brten pa/ pad+ma gzhu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kī la ya kī la ya sar+b+ba bigh+nan ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sar+b+ba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sar+b+ba pā paṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ro ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ las bum/ bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las hṝḥlas pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin/ lto ba yangs pa sogs sngar bzhin dang / badz+ra aṅku sha nas/ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ badz+ra yak+ṣi dṛ sh+ya nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gi bar dang / sha trunabha k+ṣaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa nas/ tu ṣ+ya ho'i bar dang / badz+ra yak+ṣa/ nyer mchod lnga/ sgeg sogs brgyad/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ o badz+ra san+ti baṃ/ oṃ truṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hwaṃ/ sa'i cho ga ste nub dang po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ she kha re ruṭa maṭa/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta mahā yo gi nas/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ ska ri'i bar dang / nam mkha' las phab pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs/ rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba'i bar sngar bzhin/ aṃ ku sha nas/ ā pe sha'i bar/ /badz+ra dhā tu nas/ sar+b+ba saṃ ska ra'i bar/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar bzhin/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/

/oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ lha rdzas me tog ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /sogs dang / oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar gyis mchod de lha sta gon no/ /rnam rgyal bum pa bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ hrīḥlas pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ las khro bo gnod sbyin/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ me ltar 'bar ba sngar bzhin bskyed/ /badz+ra aṅku sha nas/ ā be sha'i bar dang / badz+ra yak+ṣa/ badz+ra satwa/ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārkaka dṛ ṣ+ya sogs sbyar ba dang / sa ma a satwaṃ a haṃ/ sngags lan gsum gsum/ sngags gsum la mgor oṃ 'jug hūm̐ mjug ma la phaṭa sbyar ba gsum gsum/ sha trun bhak+ṣa/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārkaka hūm̐/ sngags gsum la mgor oṃ sbyar ba dang / oṃ med pa brjod do/ /dbang bskur/ sngags gsum gyis mchod yon nyer mchod lnga dang sgeg sogs kyis mchod/ sngags gsum bzla ste bum pa sta gon no/ /de nas phyi rol du gter ma sbyin te/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs sngar bzhin/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad tshogs bcas g.yog 'khor tshogs rnams la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /gsan nas phan gdags phyir ni 'dir byon cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gnas pa dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang /

/khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang ngam grong khyer gnas dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dang ni sum mdo dang / /gang dag lam chen dang ni shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po'am/ /seng ge dred dang gcan zan gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes te mgu bar gyur nas su/ /me tog phreng dang dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul bas/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas/ /gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams la/ /so so so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen bdun dang / /nang mi dag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /oṃ in+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ ya mā ya swā hā/ oṃ ni ri ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ bā ya be swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ī sha nā ya swā hā/ oṃ brah+ma ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ sūr+yā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ pṛ th+wī bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ge bh+yaḥswā hā/

oṃ a su ra bh+yaḥswā hā/ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsar+b+ba ta thakhaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bdag cag la bgegs med par mdzod cig las kyi dngos grub kyang bstsal du gsol/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po/ kun la 'dre/ shar lho/ gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal/ lho phyogs/ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i/ lho nub srin po'i/ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /tshig srung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /nub phyogs/ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po/ nub byang / gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs/ /nor srung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /nub byang gnod sbyin/ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po/ /byang shar dbang ldan tshogs/ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /zla ba nyi ma gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi glu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang /

/bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /mtshan brgyas bstod/ nyer mchod lnga/ lha mo brgyad/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ phyag bzhi bya/ badz+ra satwa/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming / /rdo rje dbyings ni ci nus kyis/ /cho ga bzhin du bri lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor bri/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum dang / phyag bya/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā da sogs/ mtshan brgyas bstod/ badz+ra satwa dang / nyer mchod lngas mchod/ phyag bya/ yang mtshan brgyas bstod/ badz+ra dhā tu badz+ra muḥbadz+ra kar+m+ma kaṃ nas/ badz+ra san+ti baṃ sngar bzhin te sta gon no/ /bdag rdzogs byas la thig skud sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa/ ser po traṃ las rin 'byung / dmar po/ hriḥlas 'od dpag med/ ljang ku a las don grub/ dkar po āḥlas rnam snang / mig gnyis dzaḥlas nyi zla/ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi aṅku sha dzaḥ bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po'i thig gdab pa'i phyir rdo rje'i thig bdag la stsol cig dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭa aṅku sha dzaḥ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga taḥsogs dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi zla badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭa ma ṭas mtshan pa/

badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ nyer mchod lngas mchod/ o badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ rigs lnga'i sngags brgya rtsa zla/ rigs lnga/ sems dpa' bcu drug rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags brjod/ nyer mchod lnga/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ phyag bya/ mig gnyis/ dzaḥlas nyi zla ser por snang ba/ sgeg sogs dang / rol mos mchod/ badz+ra dhā tu badz+ra kar+m+ma/ badz+ra satwa/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sems can gyi don gyi phyir 'dir gshegs par gsol/ rang rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi mig g.yas g.yon gyi hī las nyi zla/ huṃ thung ngu las mig 'bras gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje/ kro dhā dṛṣ+ṭi hīḥ/ rdul tshon bsangs sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hri aḥlas rigs lngar bskyed dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭa aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hūm̐/ rigs lnga'i sngags lan bdun bdun bzlas la/ hīḥhīḥ.oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ thig tshon byin rlabs so/ /dkyil 'khor bris tshar ba dang / dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar dang 'dra/ lha thams cad kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan sngar bzhin brjod/ badz+ra dhā tu dṛ sh+ya nas/ sar+b+ba saṃ ska ra'i bar sngar bzhin phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ tshon lhag rnams la mchod/ ye shes pa gshegs/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog sngon po g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ badz+rotagha ṭā ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ rnal 'byor chen po byas la/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ rnam rgyal dang de'i gang bum du rigs lnga dang rdo rje sems dpa' sngar bzhin bskyed/ badz+ra dhā tu oṃ badz+ra satwā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ shar gyi lha bum gang bum du/ oṃ badz+ra satwa muṣ+ṭi as mi bskyod pa'i rigs can lha brgyad sngar bzhin sprul la so so'i snying po sngar bzhin dgod/ de bzhin du lho'i bum par/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na muṣ+ṭi aḥs rin 'byung gi rigs can lha brgyad sprul zhing dgod/ nub kyi bum par/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma muṣ+ṭi aḥsogs dang / byang gi bum par/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma muṣ+ṭi aḥ sprul zhing so so'i snying po dgod/ oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ mo haṃ/ nyer mchod lnga dang / lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ badz+ra dhā tu/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ badz+ra dhā tu muṣ+ṭi aḥnas/ kar+m+ma muṣ+ṭi a'i bar brgya rtsa re/ mchod pa bsangs sbyang byin brlabs nas/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /yon chab rgyun yang mi 'chad par/ /bla ma yi dam lha la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du sbyar ro/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod bdag dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥphyag bzhi/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar 'tshal lo'i bar sngar bzhin/ gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol/ /thub pa nyi ma ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /slob dpon dpang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba/ /mi ldog pa yi 'khor los 'byor/ /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer che/

/gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba chen po bsdus pa ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur ba/ /skal pa chen po bdag la stsol/ /mtshan rnams kyis ni rgyas btab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur chen po rmad byung ba/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyi phyir/ /bdag nyid rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin zhing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'di yang 'jug par 'tshal/ /gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod ces pa'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /snying gar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje/ oṃ sar+b+ba yo ga tsit+ta uta pā da yā mi/ su ra te/ sa ma ya satwaṃ toḥ badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ badz+ra satwa/ rdor sems su gyur/ satwa badz+ri/ rat+na badz+ri/ dhar+m+ma badz+ri/ kar+m+ma badz+ri/ nyer mchod lngas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'grub pa yang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par byas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ 'di ni khyod kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin gyis gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na klad pa 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/

/gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral nas gshegs/ /oṃ u da ka ṭha/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ slob dpon aḥlas rdor sems su gyur pa'i snying gar rdo rje'i dbus su aḥrdo rje lta bu'i 'od zer dang ldan pa/ rang nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' rdul dang bral zhing shin tu dang ba'i shel ltar gyur pa'i snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje/ dpral bar traṃ las rin po che/ lkog mar hṛḥlas pad+ma/ spyi bor kaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ badz+rotagha ṭa sogs kyis slob dpon dang rang gi snying ga'i sgo phye la/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i rdo rje las aḥbyung ste rang gi snying ga'i dha'i dbus su zhugs pas aḥ rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba dang ldan pas rang gi lus thams cad gang aḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /badz+ra ā be sha aḥlan bcu brjod/ kye rdo rje sems dpa'/ kye rdo rje rin chen/ kye rdo rje chos/ kye rdo rje las/ nṛ t+ya satwa/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi snying po'i mthar badz+ra muḥbatags pa bzhi bzhi'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ ṭaruṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥpra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na satwaṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra nas/ ha ha ha hoḥ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/

/oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ lan bzhi/ satwa badzṛ sogs bzhi/ badz+ra satwa/ rang dbang stegs la 'khod/ mchod yon dang nyer mchod lngas mchod/ bkra shis brjod/ sa ma ya a/ lus kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ thugs kar rdo rje sems dpa'/ snying ga'i g.yas su rdo rje rgyal po/ g.yon du chags pa/ rgyab tu legs pa/ dpral bar rin chen/ ltag par gzi brjid/ phrag pa gnyis su rgyal mtshan/ so'i phreng ba gnyis su bzhad pa/ lkog mar chos/ nu ma gnyis kyi bar du rnon po/ lte bar rgyu/ lce la smra ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs/ nam tshogs su srung ba/ khar gnod sbyin/ dku gnyis su khu tshur/ rdor sems kyi g.yon du sgeg mo/ rdo rje rin chen gyi g.yon du phreng ba ma/ rdo rje chos kyi g.yon du rdo rje glu ma/ rdo rje las kyi g.yon du gar ma/ gsang gnas su bdug pa ma/ mgor me tog ma/ mig gnyis su mar me ma/ nu ma dang brang dang snying gar byug pa ma/ brla g.yas su lcags kyu/ g.yon du zhags pa/ byin pa g.yas su lcags sgrog g.yon du 'bebs pa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ nas/ badz+ra ā be sha a'i bar/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta satwaṃ/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/

/de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can rnams la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad grub par btul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi las dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /ces 'og ma kun la 'gre'o/ /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor ba yi bkra shis gang byung ba'i/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum bi'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas mchog rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa chen po lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtswa mchog bting bzhugs te/ /skyil mo dkrung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/

/bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po rnams yongs btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer wā rā ṇa sir drang song mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog rab bstan pa'i bkra shis gang / /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa'i rgyal po'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs te/ /man+dha ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon bstod pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lha dbang klu dbang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mtshan brgyas bstod/ lcags kyu/ bdug pa ma/ sgeg mo/ sems ma rdo rje ma/ legs pa/ chags pa/

rgyal po/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnams rang rang gi snying po la oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ btags pas rang rang gi gang bum dang / lha bum gyis dbang bskur/ de nas rnam rgyal gyi dbang bskur de bzhin du badz+ra pā sha nas/ rat+na'i bar la a bhi ṣiñtsa btags pas/ gang bum dang / lha bum/ rnam rgyal gyis dang / de bzhin du nub phyogs kyi brgyad/ rnam rgyal/ byang phyogs kyi brgyad dang / rnam rgyal/ de nas mi bskyod pa nas/ rnam snang gi bar du/ rang rang gi snying po la a bhi ṣiñtsa btags pas dbang bskur/ de nas rnam rgyal gyis so/ /oṃ dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ nas/ /oṃ kar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ gyi bar dang / oṃ truṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang nas/ /kye rdo rje dbyings kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i bar dang / ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥnas/ yid kyi gzugs ni bstan phyir ro'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad yan nas/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ gi bar brjod/ nyer mchod lnga dang sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne tra pa ha ra pa ṭa liṃ hṛḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes par gyis/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byas/ /'on te sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /aḥthams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yis/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /aḥhoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par byos shig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par bgyi'o/

/hoḥ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /gang de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di kun tu 'gro ba yin par shes par gyis shig aḥbadz+ra satwa/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa raṃ/ aḥdeng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu ma lus gang bar gyis/ /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul cho ga /'jig rten 'di la rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /kun tu khyod la srung bar byed/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du/ khro bo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /oṃ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye rdo rje dbyings kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur bhu ba swa/ gang la gzengs bstod par bya ba 'di dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i cho gas lung bstan par byas pa de la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon dang mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad do/

/'di ltar gzengs bstod pa dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog gsang ba dam pa'i dngos grub byin gyis brlabs dang / sngags kyi stobs yin no zhes dad par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ zhes bya ba 'di rang gis zungs shig /'di ni bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma'i snod du gyur pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma 'di bdag gis bstsal lags so/ /khyed 'di dang nye bar mdzod cig khyed bcom ldan 'das la 'di dang nye bar mdzod cig o badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes bya ba 'di gsungs pa 'di bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma bdag gis bzung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma'i snod du gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das ma khyed bdag dang nye bar mdzod cig lan gsum/ sngags brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /satwa badz+ri nas/ kar+m+ma badz+ri'i bar/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ra nas/ kye rdo rje dbyings kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'o'i bar dang / nyer mchod lnga dang sgeg sogs kyis mchod/ dpal kun tu bzang po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bdag 'jug go /badz+ra dhā tu aḥ badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu aḥ badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+yo haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu aḥ rat+na badz+ro haṃ/ rat+na saṃ bhā ba haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu aḥpad+mo haṃ/ a mi tā bhā bā haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu aḥ bi shwa badz+ro haṃ/ a mo gha sid+dhi haṃ/ satwa badz+ri aḥ badz+ro haṃ/ satwa badz+ri haṃ/ rat+na badz+ri aḥ rat+na haṃ/ rat+na badz+ri haṃ/ dhar+m+maḥ badz+ri aḥ pad+mo haṃ/ dhar+m+ma badz+ri haṃ/ kar+m+ma badz+ri aḥbi shwa badz+ro haṃ/ kar+m+ma badz+ri haṃ/ badz+ra satwa aḥ badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra satwa haṃ/ badz+ra rā dza aḥ aṅku sho haṃ/ badz+ra rā dzo haṃ/ /badz+ra rā ga aḥ sha ro haṃ/ badz+ra rā go haṃ/ badz+ra sā dhu aḥ tuṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ badz+ra sā dhur haṃ/ badz+ra rat+na aḥ rat+na ma haṃ/ badz+ra rat+na ma haṃ/ badz+ra te dza aḥ sūr+yo ho/ badz+ra te dzo haṃ/ badz+ra ke tu aḥ ke tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra ke tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra ha si aḥ smi ta ma haṃ/
